about: Curated current open-weight models by task. Edit this file, then run catalog.py --validate, --verify, and --write-docs. vram_gb values are estimates from file sizes, not measurements.

models.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein (base + distilled)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.turbo: distilled checkpoint in same comfy repo (flux3-image-klein-*.safetensors, 4-16 steps, cfg 1); base needs ~50 steps
models.pick_when: Top open-weights T2I on Artificial Analysis (Elo 1043, 2026-10) and #3 for editing; same weights do multi-ref edit. Not if revenue >= $5M or you need clean commercial terms.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: outputs may be used commercially only by a "Qualifying User" (affiliated gross annualized revenue < US$5M) with content filtering + AI disclosure; otherwise non-commercial Comfy repo is gated (auto-approve): harness needs an HF token that has accepted the licence. Needs ComfyUI >= 0.41.0 per docs. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/flux/flux-3-klein . VRAM is an estimate from file sizes (int8 DiT 5.8GB + TE 4.9GB + optional 6.7GB upsampler); docs say switch to bf16 with >24GB. Param count not stated in docs.

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 (+Turbo)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.turbo: Turbo checkpoint (qwen_image_2.1_turbo_*, 8 steps vs 25) and loras/qwen_image_2.1_turbo_lora_avg_rank_178_bf16.safetensors in Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1
models.pick_when: Best text rendering / 2K native / RGBA output; #2 open T2I and #2 open edit on AA. Not for any commercial job: licence is research-only (unlike Apache-2.0 Qwen-Image-2512).
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/qwen/qwen-image-2-1 . Same weights handle edit with up to 16 reference slots. Template index lists ~27GB total download for int8 t2i. VRAM estimated.

models.name: Krea 2 (Turbo / Raw)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower); int8 file for Ampere
models.turbo: Turbo checkpoint + loras/krea2_turbo_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors; also nvfp4/mxfp8 Turbo builds
models.pick_when: Aesthetic/photographic look with style LoRAs and a 1-2 image style-reference workflow. Not if revenue > $1M.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: company-wide revenue < US$1M (per krea.ai licence page; a 50-seat condition reported by secondary sources is unverified) Upstream krea/Krea-2-Turbo is gated (auto). Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/krea/krea-2 . Not on AA open leaderboard snapshot fetched 2026-10-23.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (6B)
models.min_arch: bf16: any CUDA GPU; int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.turbo: is the distilled model (8 steps); base Z-Image in Comfy-Org/Z-Image for fine-tuning
models.pick_when: Cheapest high-volume photoreal batches with a clean Apache licence; huge LoRA ecosystem. Not when you need top prompt adherence/text (AA Elo 936 vs ~1040 for leaders).
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/z-image/z-image-turbo

models.name: MOSS-Image (SFT / Base)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.turbo: community DMD distills: lodestones/MOSS-Image-SFT-8-steps-dmd (not verified for ComfyUI loading)
models.pick_when: Newest Apache-2.0 T2I with bounding-box layout control (image_moss_image_t2i_bboxes). Not yet ranked on public arenas - test before committing.
models.notes: Released ~1 week ago; quality vs FLUX3/Qwen 2.1 unverified. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/moss-image/moss-image

models.name: Bria Fibo 2.0 (Dev + Edit Turbo, 8B)
models.license: bria-fibo (upstream) / tagged cc-by-nc-4.0 on Comfy-Org repo
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: #1 open-weights image editing on AA (Elo 1088) and #3 T2I; JSON structured prompts; trained on licensed data. Not for commercial use without a Bria agreement.
models.notes: Released 2026-10-20; ComfyUI core has nodes_fibo2 but no Fibo template was in workflow_templates as of 2026-10-23 (workflow_url null). Upstream gated (auto).

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 (edit mode, up to 16 refs)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Multi-reference compositing (10 wired, 16 max), RGBA edits, background removal template. Research-only licence.
models.notes: Same weights as qwen-image-2.1 entry. Also image_qwen_image_2_1_background_removal template.

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower); int8 file for Ampere
models.pick_when: Best commercially clean (Apache) editor with a big LoRA ecosystem (multi-angle, relight, fusion). Lower quality than Fibo 2.0/Qwen 2.1 (AA Elo 991).
models.notes: 20B MMDiT. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/qwen/qwen-image-edit-2511

models.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (distilled + base)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU (bf16)
models.turbo: flux-2-klein-4b is the distilled variant; flux-2-klein-base-4b for full-step/fine-tune
models.pick_when: Fast, small, Apache-licensed multi-reference edit + T2I in one model. Quality well below FLUX 3 Klein (AA edit Elo 938).
models.notes: The 9B klein is non-commercial (flux-non-commercial-license) and its diffusion weights are not in Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Klein-9B (only text encoders/vae there).

models.name: MiniMax H3 (T2V / I2V / R2V with native stereo audio)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only; nvfp4/mxfp8 are Blackwell (sm100/sm120) formats; older GPUs dequantize (memory saving, no speedup) (text encoder ships nvfp4_awq)
models.turbo: lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo (4/8-step LoRAs, v1.3 latest; copies in Comfy-Org loras/); FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Comfy (8-step distilled DiT); FastVideo/FastH3-OmniRef-Comfy (R2V)
models.pick_when: Clearly the strongest open-weights video model (AA T2V Elo 1158, I2V 1140 - only model near closed frontier); audio+video, multi-reference R2V, continuation, ControlNet-union. Do NOT use if the operator, the RunPod region or the output audience is in the US/EU/UK/KR.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: ONLY outside the Excluded Territories (EU, UK, South Korea, USA) - use or outputs inside them are not licensed; >US$20M revenue needs written authorization; must display "MiniMax H3" in commercial UIs 33B dense per secondary sources (not in docs). Full upstream repo ~498GB; pruned int8 DiT 20.97GB + 32B VL text encoder 15.69GB (nvfp4). VRAM figure is an estimate (template index lists ~45-57GB total download). 1344x768 native, 24fps, frames snap to 17k+5. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/minimax/minimax-h3-native and https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/minimax/minimax-h3-fastvideo

models.name: LTX-2.5 (22B, audio+video, up to 4K/50fps)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only; distilled nvfp4 build also available (nvfp4/mxfp8 are Blackwell (sm100/sm120) formats; older GPUs dequantize (memory saving, no speedup))
models.turbo: distilled transformer (same repo) and loras/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors; IC-LoRA family (Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-*)
models.pick_when: Second-best open video (AA T2V 949) with synced audio, the best ecosystem of IC-LoRAs (upscale, HDR, alpha, refine) and territory-unrestricted terms under $10M. Weaker motion/quality than MiniMax H3.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: free below US$10M annual revenue (entity + affiliates); above needs paid Lightricks licence Lightricks ships ComfyUI-ready files itself (no Comfy-Org repo). Repo gated (auto) - needs HF token. Templates use comfy-core plus Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo for DFR. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/ltx/ltx-2-5 . Supersedes LTX-2.3.

models.name: Wan 2.2 T2V A14B (MoE high/low noise)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: The only top-tier video family with a plain Apache licence and the deepest LoRA/control ecosystem (VACE, Fun, Animate, S2V). Silent, 480-720p, older (2025-07) and not on AA open boards.
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan2_2 . No newer open Wan text-to-video weights (2.5/2.6/2.7 are API-only as far as verified). 5B TI2V variant (wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16) for 24GB cards.

models.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (8.3B)
models.min_arch: fp16 any; fp8_scaled variants fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.turbo: cfg-distilled and step-distilled checkpoints + 480p lightx2v 4-step LoRA; 720p/1080p SR distilled models
models.pick_when: Small and fast for 24GB cards with built-in 1080p super-resolution stage. Silent, below LTX-2.5/H3 quality.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: Tencent Hunyuan Community licence (territory excludes EU/UK/South Korea per Tencent licence family - not re-read here; MAU cap) Territory clause not verified in this session (LICENSE not opened). Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/hunyuan/hunyuan-video-1-5

models.name: MiniMax H3 I2V / FLF2V / continuation
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Best open I2V (AA 1140). Shares text encoder/VAEs with minimax-h3 entry. Same territory caveat.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: see minimax-h3 (EU/UK/KR/US excluded) Also templates video_minimax_h3_i2v_continuation, video_minimax_h3_multiframe_reference, video_minimax_h3_r2v, video_fastvideo_fasth3_i2v.

models.name: LTX-2.5 I2V / FLF2V / DFR
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Territory-unrestricted I2V with audio; first/last-frame and DFR (diffusion fidelity) modes. Plus text encoders/VAEs listed under ltx-2.5.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: < US$10M revenue ComfyUI support: native (DFR template also uses custom-node Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo) Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/ltx/ltx-2-5-dfr ; DFR template: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_ltx2_5_dfr_i2v.json

models.name: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Apache-licensed I2V workhorse with mature 4-step LoRAs and FLF2V; best when licence cleanliness or LoRA availability matters more than peak quality.
models.notes: Silent output; pair with a foley model. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan2_2

models.name: Wan Animate 2 (character animate / replace)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Drive a still character with a reference performance video, or swap a character into footage; Apache licence.
models.notes: Comfy-Org repo has no base_model metadata; upstream mapped to Wan-AI/Wan2.2-Animate-2-14B-Diffusers by name. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan-animate-2

models.name: SCAIL-2 (Wan2.1-14B character replacement)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: MIT-licensed full-body character replacement with SAM 3.1 masking and a relight LoRA. Also needs Wan 2.1 clip_vision_h/umt5/VAE (Comfy-Org/Wan-2.1).
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/zai/scail2

models.name: LTX-2.3 22B + IC-LoRAs (in/outpaint, clean-plate, ingredients, restore, style transition)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Largest catalogue of ready-made video-to-video templates: object/watermark/subtitle removal, outpainting, archival restore, depth/pose/canny control. LTX-2.5 IC-LoRAs are newer but fewer templates.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: < US$10M revenue Other templates: template_ltx2_3_lora_video_outpainting, template_ltx2_3_obscura_remova_lora_remove_object_from_video, template_ltx2_3_remove_watermark_from_video, template_ltx2_3_lora_restore_archival_footage. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/ltx/ltx-2-3

models.name: Wan 2.2 VACE-Fun A14B (v2v, ref2v, inpaint, outpaint, extension)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Apache-licensed all-in-one control/edit/extend for video; works with every Wan LoRA. Needs umt5/VAE from Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2.
models.notes: Upstream is alibaba-pai/Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B (named in Comfy-Org base_model; not queried) - hf_repo set to Wan-AI base. released month = estimate. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/vace

models.name: Netflix VOID (video object removal)
models.min_arch: fp16/bf16: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Remove an object (incl. its shadows/interactions) from footage with a SAM 3.1 mask; Apache.
models.notes: Template also pulls optical_flow/raft_large_C_T_SKHT_V2-ff5fadd5.safetensors from Comfy-Org/void-model (not size-checked). Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/void-video-inpainting

models.name: InfiniteTalk (Wan 2.1 14B audio-driven, unlimited length)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Long-form talking head / dubbing from image or video + audio, single or multi-speaker, Apache. 480p base; upscale after.
models.notes: Official template uses Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_fp8_scaled I2V/Wan2_1-I2V-14B-480p_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled_KJ.safetensors (16.64GB) as base; Comfy-Org equivalent listed here. comfy_dir for wav2vec2 assumed audio_encoders. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan-infinitetalk

models.name: LTX-2.3 ID-LoRA TalkVid (image + speech -> talking video)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Talking head with natural body/camera motion from one image + speech; DubIt IC-LoRA re-syncs lips on existing video. Licence capped at $10M.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: < US$10M revenue DubIt IC-LoRA has no official template (file verified only). ID-LoRAs are third-party (AviadDahan) repackaged by Comfy-Org.

models.name: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B (speech-to-video)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.pick_when: Audio-driven full-scene/body animation with Apache licence; alternative to InfiniteTalk for cinematic shots.
models.notes: Needs umt5 + wan_2.1_vae from Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan2-2-s2v

models.name: HuMo 17B (text+image+audio human video)
models.min_arch: fp8 matmul needs cc>=8.9 (Ada/Hopper/Blackwell); on Ampere fp8 weights load but run via dequant (slower)
models.turbo: Kijai/WanVideo_comfy Lightx2v I2V 480p distill LoRA (used by template)
models.pick_when: Subject-consistent talking/singing humans from reference image + audio + prompt. Older; InfiniteTalk usually preferred for long clips.
models.notes: Template references old repo name Comfy-Org/HuMo_ComfyUI which 307-redirects to Comfy-Org/HuMo. 1.7B variant also available.

models.name: LatentSync 1.6 (lip-sync onto existing video)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Cheap mouth-only re-sync of existing footage (dubbing) when you do not want to regenerate the shot.
models.notes: Commercial terms: yes with OpenRAIL++ use restrictions Custom node last pushed 2025-09-04; comfy_dir handled by node auto-download (null). Example workflow URL not verified. Aging - consider LTX DubIt IC-LoRA instead.

models.name: SeedVR2 3B/7B (one-step image + video restoration/upscale)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Default generative upscaler for both stills and video, Apache; 3B for video throughput, 7B/7B-sharp for stills.
models.notes: ComfyUI support: native (int8 templates); older templates use custom-node numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler Image template: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/utility_seedvr2_7b_int8_upscale_image.json . Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/seedvr2 . VRAM rises steeply with output resolution/batch; tiled VAE in template.

models.name: NVIDIA PiD (PixelDiT latent-to-4K upscaler, 4-step)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Upscale a FLUX.2/FLUX3-VAE, Qwen-Image, SD3 or SDXL latent straight to 4096px in 4 steps. Non-commercial.
models.notes: Upstream nvidia/PiD and nvidia/PixelDiT-1300M-1024px named in Comfy-Org base_model but not queried (hf_repo null). Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/nvidia/pid-latent-upscale

models.name: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (GAN)
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Near-free deterministic upscale for previews or before a generative pass. Not for restoring detail.
models.notes: Released month is the original paper/repo era, not the Comfy repackage. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/image-upscale

models.name: RIFE v4.25 heavy / FILM frame interpolation
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Temporal upscaling (16/24fps -> 48/60fps) after video generation; native nodes, no custom pack needed.
models.notes: released = Comfy-Org repo creation month. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/frame-interpolation

models.name: Pixal3D (image / multiview -> PBR mesh)
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Highest-fidelity open image-to-3D with PBR textures in native ComfyUI (built on TRELLIS.2 VAEs); multiview input supported. MIT.
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/3d/pixal3d . Multiview template: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/3d_pixal3d_multi_views.json

models.name: TRELLIS.2 4B
models.min_arch: int8_convrot: loads on any recent NVIDIA GPU; fast INT8 path reportedly needs sm>=7.5 (Turing+) - secondary sources only
models.pick_when: Proven MIT image-to-3D baseline; same template as Pixal3D lets you A/B them.
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/3d/trellis2 . Text-to-3D: no credible open end-to-end model verified - chain a T2I model into Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2.

models.name: TripoSplat (image -> 3D Gaussian splat)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU (fp16)
models.pick_when: Fast, small Gaussian-splat output (for viewers/relighting previs) instead of meshes.
models.notes: Vendor repo is itself laid out in ComfyUI folders. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/3d/triposplat

models.name: Hunyuan3D 2.1
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Mature shape generator with big community; superseded on quality by Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 in native ComfyUI.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: Tencent Hunyuan Community licence (territory/MAU terms; not re-read here) ComfyUI support: native (shape only; PBR paint stage needs custom nodes) Hunyuan3D 3.x appears API-only (no open repo found in HF search).

models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Best all-round Apache TTS: 3s voice cloning, natural-language voice design, multilingual. Most-starred ComfyUI TTS node (1955 stars, pushed 2026-10-23).
models.notes: Node downloads full repo; comfy_dir decided by node. ComfyUI core has no TTS node as of v0.42.1. Example workflow URL not verified.

models.name: VoxCPM2
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Tokenizer-free, very natural prosody voice cloning, Apache; ~925k monthly HF downloads.
models.notes: Quality ranking vs Qwen3-TTS not independently verified.

models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: MIT voice cloning with emotion control and 23 languages; official Comfy template exists (TTS, dialog, multilingual, voice conversion).

models.pick_when: MIT-licensed, fast song generation with editing/repaint; the safe commercial default.
models.notes: Comfy-Org repo tagged apache-2.0, upstream MIT. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/ace-step/ace-step-v1-5

models.pick_when: Instrumentals, stems, loops and SFX from one model family; trained on licensed data. Large model is API-only.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: free under US$1M annual revenue; Enterprise licence above Qwen3.5-2B is the template prompt expander. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/stable-audio/stable-audio-3

models.name: YuE2 3B (lyrics-to-song, covers)

models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Standalone video+text -> 48kHz foley with good sync; works on any model's silent output.
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: Tencent Hunyuan Community licence (not re-read here) .pth pickles (not safetensors) - load with care. Custom nodes are small community projects (64 stars max); none official.

models.name: MMAudio large 44k v2
models.license: cc-by-nc-4.0 (upstream weights; Kijai repackage tagged mit)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Fast, light, well-synced V2A for prototyping. Non-commercial weights; old (2024-12).
models.notes: comfy_dir models/mmaudio per kijai node convention (not re-verified from node README).

models.name: Stable Audio 3 small-sfx (text-to-SFX)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Text-prompted SFX library generation (not synced to video).
models.notes: Commercial terms: conditional: < US$1M revenue No dedicated small-sfx template verified; medium template uses the same loader - swap checkpoint. Inference behaviour of small-sfx in that template not verified.

models.name: Xiaomi ControlFoley (V2A, text/audio-conditioned)
models.pick_when: Newest research V2A with timbre/audio-reference control (ACM MM 2026). Non-commercial; tiny user base (8 stars).
models.notes: VRAM unverified. Also needs ext_weights/* from same repo.

models.name: SAM 3.1 (text-prompted image/video segmentation)
models.min_arch: any CUDA GPU
models.pick_when: Masks for inpaint/character replacement/VOID from a text prompt, tracked through video. Upstream is manually gated - use the Comfy-Org mirror.
models.notes: Commercial terms: yes per SAM licence (not re-read here); upstream gated manual Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/video-segment-sam3

models.name: Depth Anything 3 (mono/metric large)
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Default depth for ControlNet/IC-LoRA conditioning, image and video.
models.notes: Only mono-large/metric-large confirmed Apache via DA3MONO-LARGE card; DA3 giant variants may differ. Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/depth-anything-3

models.name: BiRefNet (+ lucida) background removal
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Native cut-outs for product shots and 3D input prep; Qwen-Image 2.1 RGBA is the generative alternative.
models.notes: lucida.safetensors is from egeorcun/lucida (licence not checked). Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/remove-background-birefnet

models.name: SDPose wholebody + RT-DETR v4 detector
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Multi-person pose maps (image/video) for pose ControlNets and Animate pipelines, natively - replaces DWPose from controlnet_aux.
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/pose-detection-sdpose

models.name: MoGe 3 (monocular geometry: depth, normals, point maps)
models.min_arch: any
models.pick_when: Normals/metric geometry and image/panorama-to-mesh; used inside the Pixal3D template.
models.notes: Docs: https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/utility/moge

workflows.name: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
workflows.note: Source of the in-app template browser; ~719 JSONs incl. api_* (closed-model) ones. templates/index.json carries date, total download size and model URLs per template - machine-readable for a harness.

workflows.name: ComfyUI docs tutorials (index)
workflows.note: LLM-friendly index of all ~256 tutorial pages; every model in this catalogue with native support has a page here.

workflows.name: ComfyUI releases
workflows.note: Core repo moved from comfyanonymous/ComfyUI to Comfy-Org/ComfyUI; v0.42.1 (2026-10-19) current; FLUX 3 Klein needs >=0.41.0. Release cadence ~weekly - pin versions in pod images.

workflows.name: ComfyUI docs changelog
workflows.note: Per-release notes on new native model support.

workflows.name: ComfyUI_examples (legacy)
workflows.note: Last pushed 2025-11-26 - effectively superseded by workflow_templates; do not use for 2026 models.

workflows.name: Trend: Comfy-Org-native everything + int8_convrot
workflows.note: Since mid-2026 nearly every new open model ships native core nodes (nodes_minimax_h3, trellis2, seedvr, sam3, yue2, ...) plus Comfy-Org repacks in int8_convrot / fp8_scaled / mxfp8 / nvfp4. int8_convrot is now the default precision in templates (Ampere-friendly). Kijai wrapper packs matter less.

workflows.name: Trend: Comfy-Org HF repo renames (2026-09-23)
workflows.note: Old names (Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged, Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI, flux2-dev, HuMo_ComfyUI, hunyuan3D_2.1_repackaged) now 307-redirect to new names (Wan-2.1, Qwen-Image-Edit, Flux-2-Dev, HuMo, Hunyuan-3D-2.1). Templates still reference old names - downloader must follow redirects.

workflows.name: Trend: joint audio+video models
workflows.note: MiniMax H3 and LTX-2.5 generate synced audio natively; foley/V2A becomes a fallback step for Wan-family output.

workflows.name: Trend: in-graph LLM prompt expansion
workflows.note: Templates now chain TextGenerate (Qwen3.5 / Gemma 4) prompt upsamplers before the diffusion model (FLUX3 Klein, Qwen-Image 2.1, Stable Audio 3, LTX-2.5) - budget 5-10GB extra VRAM or disable.

workflows.name: Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo
workflows.note: Official LTX nodes (4210 stars, pushed 2026-10-20) - needed for DFR, foley and many IC-LoRA workflows.

workflows.name: kijai/ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper
workflows.note: Historic Wan bleeding-edge wrapper (6743 stars) but last pushed 2026-05-24 - most Wan variants are now native; use only for features not in core.

workflows.name: kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
workflows.note: Utility pack still used by official templates (e.g. SUPIR upscale); pushed 2026-10-23. Includes Sage-attention patch / torch.compile helper nodes.

workflows.name: nunchux-ai/ComfyUI-nunchaku (SVDQuant 4-bit)
workflows.note: 4-bit SVDQuant inference (2931 stars, pushed 2026-09-06); model coverage lags the newest models - check before relying on it. Org name changed from earlier nunchaku-tech.

workflows.name: SageAttention
workflows.note: Quantized attention kernels (3973 stars); launch ComfyUI with --use-sage-attention; biggest win on long video sequences. Last push 2026-01-17.

workflows.name: ComfyUI-MagCache
workflows.note: Step-skipping cache (successor to TeaCache); last push 2025-11 - may not cover 2026 architectures. Core now ships EasyCache (comfy_extras/nodes_easycache) natively.

workflows.name: ComfyUI-TeaCache
workflows.note: Older timestep-embedding cache; unmaintained since 2025-07 - prefer EasyCache/MagCache or distill LoRAs.

workflows.name: Distill LoRAs (lightx2v)
workflows.note: 4/8-step distillation LoRAs are the dominant batch-cost lever in 2026 (MiniMax H3, Wan 2.2, Qwen-Image-Edit, HunyuanVideo 1.5); bigger saving than caching.

workflows.name: FastVideo FastH3
workflows.note: 8-step distilled MiniMax H3 DiTs (T2V/I2V and OmniRef R2V) packaged for ComfyUI with official templates video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v / video_fasth3_ominiref_r2v.

workflows.name: torch.compile (core node)
workflows.note: Native TorchCompileModel node; worthwhile on long batch runs where compile time amortises.

workflows.name: Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux
workflows.note: Classic preprocessors (lineart, softedge, etc.) still maintained (pushed 2026-10-11); depth/pose/seg now better done with native DA3/SDPose/SAM3.

workflows.name: diodiogod/TTS-Audio-Suite
workflows.note: Multi-engine TTS pack (Chatterbox, Qwen, etc.); fills the gap left by no core TTS.
